content_sections.heading: BTSC Food Safety Officer Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Online applications for BTSC Food Safety Officer Recruitment 2026 started on 25 September 2026. Candidates must submit the application form and required supporting documents by 24 October 2026 through the official BTSC website.

content_sections.heading: BTSC Food Safety Officer Vacancy 2026 Category-wise Details
content_sections.text: The Bihar Technical Service Commission has advertised 105 Food Safety Officer vacancies, including 105 regular posts and 34 backlog posts. The notification provides separate category-wise vacancy distributions. The notification provides 35% horizontal reservation for eligible women who are original residents of Bihar. It also identifies disability-related reservation and other horizontal reservation provisions under the applicable state rules. Candidates claiming reservation must possess the relevant Bihar domicile, caste, non-creamy-layer, EWS or disability certificates in the prescribed format.

content_sections.heading: BTSC Food Safety Officer Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must possess a recognized Bachelor's, Master's or Doctorate degree in one of the following notified disciplines, as applicable: Food Technology Dairy Technology Biotechnology Oil Technology Agricultural Science Veterinary Science Biochemistry Microbiology Chemistry Food Science Medicine The notification also recognizes certain degree specializations under Food Technology and Agricultural Science. These include: Candidates must check their exact qualification against the prescribed medical degree list before applying.

content_sections.heading: BTSC Food Safety Officer Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The minimum age required for BTSC Food Safety Officer Recruitment 2026 is 21 years as on 1 August 2026. The maximum age varies by category. Age Reckoning Date: 01 August 2026. Eligible Persons with Disabilities: 10 years of relaxation in the maximum age limit. Eligible Bihar Government employees with at least three years of qualifying continuous service: 5 years of relaxation, subject to the notification conditions.

content_sections.heading: BTSC Food Safety Officer Salary 2026
content_sections.text: The Food Safety Officer post carries Pay Level 6 under the revised Bihar Government pay structure. The notification also specifies unrevised Grade Pay Rs. 4,200 under Pay Band 2.

content_sections.heading: BTSC Food Safety Officer Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The Bihar Technical Service Commission has prescribed an application fee of Rs. 100 for the recruitment. The payment must be completed online. Applications without the required fee payment will not be considered. The application fee is non-refundable.

content_sections.heading: BTSC Food Safety Officer Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection for the Bihar Food Safety Officer posts will be based on a Computer Based Written Examination. Candidates will also have to fulfill the prescribed eligibility and document verification requirements. Computer Based Test: Eligible candidates will appear for an objective-type competitive examination. Preparation of Results: Marks will be normalized if the examination is conducted in multiple shifts. Document Verification: The Commission will verify educational, age, reservation and other supporting certificates.

content_sections.heading: BTSC Food Safety Officer Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The BTSC FSO written examination will consist of 100 objective-type questions for 100 marks. The examination duration is two hours. Each incorrect answer will result in a deduction of 0.25 marks. Applicants must secure the applicable minimum qualifying marks to remain eligible for consideration. Merely securing the qualifying marks does not guarantee selection.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in BTSC Food Safety Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: BTSC has advertised 105 Food Safety Officer vacancies under Advertisement No. 29/2026, including 105 regular and 34 backlog vacancies.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for BTSC Food Safety Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 24 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. When did BTSC Food Safety Officer online registration start?
faq.answer: Online applications started on 25 September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for BTSC Food Safety Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an accepted degree in Food Technology, Dairy Technology, Biotechnology, Agriculture, Veterinary Science, Biochemistry, Microbiology, Chemistry, Food Science, Medicine or another discipline specified in the advertisement.

faq.question: Q5. Can B.Sc Agriculture graduates apply for BTSC Food Safety Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. Agricultural Science is an accepted qualification route, subject to the exact degree and specialization requirements specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Can Food Technology graduates apply for BTSC FSO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates with recognized Food Technology degrees and qualifying specializations listed in the advertisement can apply.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for BTSC Food Safety Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 21 years as on 1 August 2026. The maximum age is 37 years for unreserved male candidates, 40 years for eligible female and BC/EBC candidates, and 42 years for SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for BTSC Food Safety Officer posts?
faq.answer: The Food Safety Officer post carries revised Pay Level 6, with unrevised Grade Pay Rs. 4,200 under Pay Band 2.

faq.question: Q9. What is the BTSC Food Safety Officer application fee?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 100. Payment must be completed online through the permitted methods.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for BTSC Food Safety Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a Computer Based Written Examination, followed by the prescribed eligibility and document verification process.
